During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a group of [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cultists]] '''traveled''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]] in the [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]] and attempted to disperse a [[Anti-Caarite virus|deadly virus]] on the world, to wipe out most of the native [[Caarite]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The cultists had manufactured the infection inside a [[S-Ipsus Believers laboratory|secret laboratory]] on the planet [[Genarius]] and were able to flee with several barrels of the virus shortly before the lab was destroyed by a strike team sent by the Caarite-operated [[Metatheran Cartel]]. Led by the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Crymsin Ost]], the Believers journeyed to Caarimon and some of the cultists landed on the world, while Ost and several of her followers boarded the orbiting research station [[Creautaa-V]] and wiped out the installation's crew. The ground team placed a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] on a fault line in the [[Desolation]] region of Caarimon and Ost planned to crash a [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] filled with the virus onto the transmitter, to both unleash the infection and trigger and environmental catastrophe. However, the [[Cularin Militia]], a military force from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], learned of the plot and dispatched a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] to Caarimon, to thwart the Believers. The agents landed on the world and disabled the transmitter in the Desolation, then flew up Creautaa-V and defeated Ost's team, averting the crisis. Shortly afterward, a party was held in the [[Greentree Pointe]] resort on the world [[Dorumaa]] in honor of the agents, to commend them for their efforts during the mission.
